title: Eid e zainab koi zainab se zara puche to
body:
Eid e ZAINAB koi ZAINAB se Zara puche to
Kyu'n hai Wo Eid pe bhi mehwe Aza puche to
Kyu'n Nahi'n AALE MUHAMMAD ke gharo'n me'n khushiyan
Kya sabab hai ye koi jaake bhala puche to
Eid e Ramazan e Mubarak ho Ya Eid e Qurba'n
Majlis e Gham kyu'n hai ghar Inke Bapa puche to
Loot kar Eid ki har ek Khushi Kufe me'n,
Kaisi Ummat ne Nibhaayi hai Wafa puchhe to
Kya diya Ajr RISALAT ka Musalmaano’n ne
AALE AHMAD ko Bajuz Zulm o Jafa puchhe to...
Ha'n Usi Subh ko jo Banke qayamat aayi,
Kiska sar Sajde me'n do neem hua puchhe to
Phe'nk kar Daarul Imaara se ba Roz e Arafah
Kis ke Laashe ko Ghasita tha gaya puchche to
Kyu'n hai SAJJAD ki Aankho'n se Rawa'n Khoon e Jigar
Kaun sa zakhm abhi tak na bhara  puchche to
Jis Gharaane se thi Eidain ki Zinat Aakhir,
Kyu'n hai Ghar Aaj Wohi Nauhakuna puchhe to
Kabhi BABA to BARADAR ko kabhi Roti hai
Uski har Eid hai kyu'n Karb o bala puchhe to
Unke Haq me'n jo Sada karta raha Haq se Dua
Kyu'n kar Ummat ne Usey Zibh kiya puchhe to
Waqt har zakhm ko bhar de ye zaruri to Nahi'n
Kaisa ye Huzn hai ye Dard Hai Kya puchhe to
Khoon e Dil Aankho'n se Ro Ro ke  Wila aur Shabih
Aaj MAHDI bhi hai'n kyu'n Mehwe Buka puchhe to...
